data.name: ProviderConfirmRun
data.comment: {0} = result title. Inline confirm bar for a provider row marked ConfirmLaunch.

data.name: ProviderActionFailed
data.comment: {0} = result title. Shown on the error line when a provider action returns false.

data.name: ProviderActionError
data.comment: {0} = result title, {1} = exception message. Shown on the error line when a provider action throws.

data.name: SettingsUseWindowsAccent
data.comment: Settings page checkbox label; the panel accent follows the Windows accent color.

data.name: SettingsIncludeOtherDesktopWindows
data.comment: Settings page checkbox label: the window switcher also lists windows on other virtual desktops / hidden tiling-WM workspaces.

data.name: WindowSubtitleOtherDesktopSuffix
data.comment: Appended to an open-window row's subtitle (keep the leading space and separator).

data.name: CalcSubtitle
data.comment: {0} = the expression as typed. Subtitle of the calculator row.

data.name: CalcSubtitleHex
data.comment: {0} = the expression as typed, {1} = the integer result in hex (e.g. 0x30). Subtitle of the calculator row.

data.name: SysCmdSubtitle
data.comment: Subtitle shared by all built-in system command rows.

data.name: SysCmdLock
data.comment: System command title: lock the PC.

data.name: SysCmdSignOut
data.comment: System command title: log off the current user.

data.name: EditorQueryHint
data.value: Use {query} for text typed after a keyword
data.comment: Editor hint under the URL, command and arguments fields; {query} is a literal placeholder, do not translate it.

data.name: EditorHotkeyHint
data.value: Press a key combination, Backspace clears
data.comment: Editor hint next to the item hotkey box.

data.name: EditorHotkeyConflictItem
data.comment: Editor error. {0} = hotkey, {1} = other item name.

data.name: EditorHotkeyInvalid
data.value: '{0}' is not a valid key combination.

data.name: HotkeyItemInvalid
data.value: Hotkey '{1}' for '{0}' is not a valid key combination.

data.name: HotkeyItemInUse
data.value: Hotkey {1} for '{0}' is already in use by another program.

data.name: HotkeyItemConflictMain
data.value: Hotkey {1} for '{0}' is the panel hotkey, so it was skipped.

data.name: HotkeyItemConflictItem
data.value: Hotkey {1} for '{0}' is already used by '{2}', so it was skipped.
data.comment: Tray balloon. {0} = item name, {1} = hotkey, {2} = the item that owns it.

data.name: HotkeyItemsMore
data.comment: Tray balloon tail. {0} = number of further problems.

data.name: WindowSubtitle
data.comment: {0} = process name (e.g. chrome). Subtitle of an open-window row.

data.name: WindowSubtitleNoApp
data.comment: Subtitle of an open-window row whose application could not be determined.

data.name: SettingsImportStartMenu
data.comment: Settings page button: opens the Start-menu app picker.

data.name: StartMenuFolderName
data.comment: Name of the root folder the Start-menu import creates.

data.name: StartMenuBreadcrumb
data.comment: Breadcrumb suffix on the Start-menu picker page.

data.name: StartMenuPickerHint
data.value: Type to filter Space toggle Ctrl+A all ↵ import Esc cancel
data.comment: Hint bar text on the Start-menu picker page.

data.name: StartMenuFilterPlaceholder
data.comment: Placeholder of the picker's filter box.

data.name: StartMenuLoading
data.comment: Status line while the Start menu is being scanned.

data.name: StartMenuImporting
data.comment: Status line after Enter while the selected shortcuts are being resolved.

data.name: StartMenuNoApps
data.value: No apps found in the Start menu.
data.comment: Status line when the scan found nothing.

data.name: StartMenuNoMatches
data.comment: Status line when the filter hides every app.

data.name: StartMenuKindStore
data.comment: Right-hand label of a packaged app in the picker.

data.name: StartMenuKindDesktop
data.comment: Right-hand label of a classic desktop app in the picker.

data.name: StartMenuScanFailed
data.value: Could not read the Start menu: {0}

data.name: StartMenuImportFailed
data.value: Could not import from the Start menu: {0}

data.name: StartMenuImportDone
data.value: Start menu import: {0} added, {1} updated, {2} removed (folder '{3}').
data.comment: {0} added, {1} updated, {2} removed nodes; {3} = folder name.

data.name: PluginSearching
data.comment: Placeholder row while a plugin runs. {0} = plugin name.

data.name: PluginsSkipped
data.comment: Tray balloon heading; followed by one line per plugin that could not be loaded.

data.name: SettingsOpenPluginsFolder
data.comment: Settings page button: opens (and creates if missing) the plugins folder.

data.name: FileSearchPending
data.comment: Single placeholder row shown while a file search ("f report") is running.

data.name: SettingsFileSearchPrefix
data.comment: Settings label of the text that, followed by a space, switches the list to file search.

data.name: SettingsFileSearchPrefixHint
data.value: e.g. "f report"; empty turns file search off
data.comment: Hint next to the file search prefix box.

data.name: NavEmptyFolder
data.value: This folder is empty — press Ctrl+N to add
data.comment: List empty state in a folder.

data.name: HintNav
data.value: ↵ open → enter ← back Ctrl+N add F2 edit Ctrl+I icon Del delete
data.comment: Hint bar, list page. Key names stay as is.

data.name: HintSearch
data.value: ↵ open Ctrl+↵ show in folder Esc clear

data.name: HintEditor
data.value: Enter save Esc cancel Alt+A advanced

data.name: HintIconPicker
data.value: Ctrl+Tab tab ↑↓←→ move ↵ apply Ctrl+0 default Esc cancel

data.name: HintSettings
data.value: Tab move Enter save Esc cancel

data.name: HintCut

data.comment: {0} = count. Secondary text of a folder row.

data.comment: Appended to a read-only error line.

data.name: DeleteSeparatorConfirm

data.value: Delete folder '{0}' and its {1} item? Enter = delete, Esc = cancel

data.name: DeleteFolderConfirmMany
data.value: Delete folder '{0}' and its {1} items? Enter = delete, Esc = cancel

data.name: ImportConfirm
data.value: Import this config? M = Merge (append; renames colliding ids) · R = Replace (keeps current settings) · Esc = cancel
data.comment: Confirm bar. M and R are key names.

data.name: BookmarksImportedReplacedOne
data.value: Imported {0} bookmark from {1} (replaced the previous import).

data.name: BookmarksImportedReplacedMany
data.value: Imported {0} bookmarks from {1} (replaced the previous import).

data.name: MoveIntoItself
data.value: Cannot move a folder into itself.

data.name: ReloadPending
data.value: config.json changed — will reload once you finish this.

data.name: ReloadSaveRefused
data.value: config.json changed on disk — your edit was not saved; reopen and redo it.

data.name: ConfigHasErrors
data.value: config.json has errors — kept the previous version.

data.name: ConfigReadOnly
data.value: Config is read-only because config.json could not be read. Fix or restore it first.

data.name: ConfigLoadFailed
data.value: Config could not be read: {0}. Using an empty tree; the file was not modified.

data.name: TrayUpdated
data.value: Updated to {0}. Click to see what's new.
